title: Cold Weather Alerts Issued as UK Faces Freezing Temperatures
subtitle: Health officials warn of risks to vulnerable people and healthcare services as winter weather arrives.

summary.en: The UK has issued urgent cold weather and health alerts for parts of Scotland and northern England. The Met Office warned of ice and snow, while the UK Health Security Agency noted risks to health services. Officials are particularly concerned about the impact on elderly people and those with existing health conditions. Experts advise people to stay warm and check on vulnerable neighbors during this cold snap. The cold weather is expected to continue through the week with potential for further warnings.
summary.zh: 英國已針對蘇格蘭與英格蘭北部部分地區發布緊急低溫與健康警報。英國氣象局警告會有結冰與降雪，英國健康安全局則指出醫療服務面臨的風險。官員特別擔憂寒流對長者與患有既有疾病者的影響。專家建議民眾保持溫暖，並在寒流期間關心弱勢鄰居。預計寒冷天氣將持續一週，未來可能會有更多警報。

paragraphs.en: As winter weather arrives in the United Kingdom, authorities have issued new warnings for cold temperatures and icy conditions. Following recent reports on the arrival of a cold snap, the Met Office has now set yellow weather warnings for ice across central and eastern Scotland. These warnings are expected to last from Sunday evening until Monday morning, creating difficult conditions for people walking on footpaths.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著冬季氣候降臨英國，當局已針對低溫與結冰狀況發布新的警報。繼近期關於寒流來襲的報導後，英國氣象局（Met Office）現已針對蘇格蘭中部與東部發布黃色結冰警報。這些警報預計將從週日晚間持續至週一上午，恐對在人行道上行走的民眾造成困難。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the risk of ice, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) has issued yellow cold health alerts for several regions, including north-west and north-east England, as well as Yorkshire and the Humber. These alerts, which come into force on Sunday night and remain active until Thursday morning, highlight the potential impact of the freezing weather on health and social care services. According to the UKHSA, the cold weather is likely to lead to an increased use of healthcare services and poses a greater risk to the lives of vulnerable individuals.
paragraphs.zh: 除了結冰風險外，英國健康安全局（UKHSA）也針對英格蘭西北部、東北部，以及約克郡與亨伯地區發布了黃色低溫健康警報。這些警報將於週日晚間生效，並持續至週四上午，凸顯了嚴寒天氣對醫療與社會照護服務的潛在影響。根據英國健康安全局指出，寒冷天氣極可能導致醫療服務需求增加，並對弱勢族群的生命安全構成更大風險。

paragraphs.en: This cold weather is caused by northerly winds and longer nights, according to Dan Stroud, a senior operational meteorologist at the Met Office. The impact of the low temperatures was already visible over the weekend, with Suffolk recording the lowest temperature in the UK at -4.5C. Looking ahead, the Met Office noted that snow could fall on hills in northern England and Scotland in the coming days. While the weather might become briefly milder in the middle of the week, it is expected to return to cold conditions as the weekend approaches, with widespread frost likely in the north.
paragraphs.zh: 英國氣象局資深作業氣象學家丹·史特勞德（Dan Stroud）表示，這波寒冷天氣是由北風與夜晚時間變長所導致。低溫的影響在週末已顯而易見，薩福克郡（Suffolk）測得英國最低溫攝氏零下四點五度。展望未來，氣象局指出，未來幾天英格蘭北部與蘇格蘭的山區可能會降雪。雖然週中天氣可能會短暫回暖，但預計週末將再度轉冷，北部地區極可能出現大範圍霜凍。

paragraphs.en: Public health experts are urging the public to take precautions. Paul Coleman, a consultant in public health at the UKHSA, explained that this is the latest in a series of cold health alerts for the season, and more are expected as winter continues. He emphasized that cold weather can have a serious impact on the health of people aged 65 and over, as well as those with pre-existing health conditions. Coleman advised that people should try to heat the rooms they use the most and dress warmly during these colder periods. He also suggested that it is vital to check in on friends, family, and neighbors who may be most at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 公共衛生專家呼籲民眾採取預防措施。英國健康安全局公共衛生顧問保羅·柯曼（Paul Coleman）解釋，這是本季一系列低溫健康警報中的最新一波，隨著冬季持續，預計還會有更多警報。他強調，寒冷天氣會對六十五歲以上長者以及患有既有疾病者的健康造成嚴重影響。柯曼建議，民眾應盡量為常使用的房間供暖，並在寒冷期間穿著保暖。他也建議，務必關心身邊可能處於高風險的親友與鄰居。

paragraphs.en: These health alerts arrive at a challenging time for the National Health Service (NHS). Recent reports have shown that the NHS in England is struggling to meet its treatment goals, including for cancer patients. With only about 70% of patients starting treatment within 62 days—falling short of the 80% target—there is concern that the added pressure from cold-related illnesses could make the situation worse. The UKHSA noted that the current weather is likely to have minor impacts on health and social care services, which may add to existing difficulties.
paragraphs.zh: 這些健康警報發布之際，正值英國國家醫療保健服務（NHS）面臨挑戰的時刻。近期報告顯示，英格蘭的國家醫療保健服務在達成治療目標方面陷入困境，包括癌症病患的治療。目前僅約百分之七十的病患能在六十二天內開始治療，未達百分之八十的目標，令人擔憂寒冷相關疾病帶來的額外壓力恐使情況惡化。英國健康安全局指出，目前的天氣可能會對醫療與社會照護服務造成輕微影響，進而加劇現有的困難。

paragraphs.en: As the week progresses, the Met Office indicated that further weather warnings could be issued. While high pressure might bring brighter weather from the middle of the week, the north will remain cold with temperatures staying below normal. For now, the focus remains on keeping people safe and ensuring that those most vulnerable to the cold receive the support they need. The public is encouraged to stay updated with the latest weather reports as the situation develops.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著本週進展，英國氣象局表示可能會發布更多天氣警報。雖然高氣壓可能在週中帶來較明朗的天氣，但北部地區仍將保持寒冷，氣溫維持在正常水準以下。目前，重點仍放在確保民眾安全，並確保最易受寒冷影響的族群能獲得所需支援。當局鼓勵民眾隨時關注最新天氣報導，以掌握情況發展。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To become effective or start to apply (usually referring to a rule, law, or alert).
keyTerms.definitionZh: （法規、警告等）開始生效、開始實施。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於法律或正式公告，這裡指天氣警報開始生效。文中：These alerts, which come into force on Sunday night and remain active until Thursday morning, highlight the potential impact of the freezing weather on health and social care services.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to reach a target or standard.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指未達到預期的醫療服務目標。文中：With only about 70% of patients starting treatment within 62 days—falling short of the 80% target—there is concern that the added pressure from cold-related illnesses could make the situation worse.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To visit or contact someone to make sure they are safe or okay.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 去探望或聯繫某人，確認對方平安無事。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指關心高風險族群的健康狀況。文中：He also suggested that it is vital to check in on friends, family, and neighbors who may be most at risk.

previousArticles.summaryEn: The NHS in England is expected to miss its target for treating cancer patients on time by nearly 10,000 people. Regional differences and variations between cancer types further complicate the situation for patients. Without significant changes, health professionals warn that these missed targets could continue for years.

quiz.question: According to the article, how long are the cold health alerts issued by the UKHSA expected to last?

options.A: From Sunday evening until Monday morning
options.B: From Sunday night until Thursday morning
options.C: Throughout the entire duration of the winter season
options.D: Until the middle of the week when temperatures rise

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，UKHSA 發布的寒冷健康警報（cold health alerts）明確指出這些警報從週日晚上開始，持續到週四早上。選項 A 是 Met Office 對蘇格蘭地區發布的結冰警報（ice warnings）的時間，而非 UKHSA 的健康警報。選項 C 錯誤，因為文中提到這只是「一系列」警報中的一個，並非整個冬季。選項 D 雖然提到週中氣溫可能短暫回升，但並非警報結束的定義。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the current cold weather be particularly concerning for the NHS?

options.A: Because the NHS is currently experiencing a shortage of heating fuel for its hospitals
options.B: Because the cold weather is expected to cause more cancer cases in the UK
options.C: Because the health service is already failing to meet its performance targets
options.D: Because the NHS has not received any guidance from the UKHSA on how to handle the cold

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。第五段提到 NHS 目前在治療目標（如癌症治療）上已經表現不佳，僅達到 70% 而非目標的 80%。文章推論寒冷天氣帶來的額外病患壓力會「加劇」現有的困難。選項 A 文中未提及醫院燃料短缺。選項 B 錯誤，文中提到的是治療延遲，而非寒冷導致癌症增加。選項 D 錯誤，文中顯示 UKHSA 與 NHS 之間有資訊交流，且並未提到缺乏指引。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'vital' mean as it is used in the context of checking on neighbors?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第四段中，作者建議關心親友是「vital」，意指這件事對於保護弱勢族群的健康與安全至關重要，屬於「極其重要」之意。選項 B 將 vital 誤解為「充滿活力」，在句意中不通。選項 C 雖有關心鄰居的行為，但 vital 強調的是「必要性」而非「習慣」。選項 D 錯誤，這並非單指醫療行為，而是一種社會互助建議。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the article?

options.A: To explain the meteorological causes of the recent cold snap in the UK
options.B: To provide a detailed guide on how to survive extreme winter weather
options.C: To report on the current cold weather warnings and the associated public health risks
options.D: To criticize the UK government for its failure to support the NHS during winter

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章從氣象局的結冰警報、UKHSA 的健康警報，到對弱勢族群的建議以及對 NHS 的潛在影響，核心主旨皆圍繞在「寒冷天氣帶來的警報與公衛風險」。選項 A 僅是文章的一小部分（第三段）。選項 B 過於誇大，文中僅提供基本建議，並非詳細指南。選項 D 雖然提到 NHS 的困境，但文章語氣是客觀報導而非批評政府。
